P_0x00A048: Captain of the Gaia Sabers' "Alpha Saber" squad. A skilled pilot riding the Canis Altarf. Arrogant, he hides his face behind a mask.
P_0x00A134: Rides the Galilnagant, sworn to obey Alteur. Cool, proud. Merciless to enemies; turns savage when emotions run high in battle.
P_0x00A244: RCommander of "GS," the Gaia Sabers, under the <Earth Fed Gov't> President. Near the <Inspector Incident> she approached Graien Grusman via Nibhal Mubhal, earning special aide. Cold, ambitious.
P_0x00A3C2: &A Gaia Sabers scientist. Once studied <Aerogater> materials at <DC>, then used the data to develop metal cells called <Machine Cell>. Also developed the <Geim System>.
P_0x00A50C: Kouryu is read "Ganron." Leader-like figure of the Baral. Flashy hedonist in a white suit. "Son Kouryu" is an alias; real name Aqlab Avot.
P_0x00A62A: A Baral member. Once a princess of an ancient Japan realm razed by the Baral. Captured for her shaman gifts, she serves the Baral since.
